summary: A free Sunday 4-8 PM drop-in game night hosted by Nightshade, a non-alcoholic social lounge in South Slope, Asheville, where guests can play the house collection of board/card games or bring their own. There is no membership language, sign-up, or club identity in the listings, and the venue's own website doesn't mention game night as a program at all, focusing instead on DJ sets and live music - this reads as a one-off/occasional venue promo, matching the sibling venue game nights (Hi-Wire, RAD Brewing, Oak and Grist, Plant Bar) already classified not_group.

evidence.note: Listing invites guests to 'gather your crew' and choose from the house game collection or bring their own; no mention of members, regulars, or a group identity.
Only 2 occurrences over ~10 days (2025-12-28, 2026-01-06) rather than an established weekly/biweekly cadence, suggesting an occasional promo rather than a standing recurring program.

Nightshade's own website describes itself as a non-alcoholic social lounge featuring DJ sets, live music, and zero-proof cocktails; it makes no mention of game night as an ongoing program, indicating the event is a one-off venue promotion rather than a hosted club.
